{{Top|leg}}
The '''First Imperial Bank of Core''', or simply '''First Imperial Bank''', was a financial institution. Members of the [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanese]] [[Species/Legends|species]] were highly visible employees for the bank.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[White Thranta Shipping Company|White Thranta]] criminal [[Durr Roddack]] owned the account A37TDX41. After killing Roddack,<ref name="SWG:SO">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Shipping Out|Tatooine}}</ref> a spacer transferred all the content of his bank account to his own, in the [[First Galactic Bank of Ord Mantell]].<ref name="SWG:AF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Appropriating Funds|Tatooine}}</ref>
